description: Volume plausibility check for an EVM token's DEX pairs (DexScreener): 24h volume against liquidity, average trade size from 24h trade counts, and buy/sell balance, for the 3 deepest pairs. A heuristic that flags suspicious volume (for example volume 20x liquidity); it cannot see wallets, so it does not prove wash trading. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

chain.description: Chain name as DexScreener uses it, e.g. base, ethereum, solana, bsc (default base)

name: agent_intel_wash_trading_volume_filter
